content_data.project_title: Real-Time Social Media Sentiment Analytics Engine for European Markets
content_data.project_description: Development of a distributed microservices platform that processes social media data streams in real-time to deliver actionable sentiment insights for consulting clients across European markets. The system will support multi-language processing and comply with GDPR requirements.
content_data.timeline: 14 months with Phase 1: Architecture & Core Services (months 1-5), Phase 2: ML Integration & Language Support (months 6-10), Phase 3: Testing & Deployment (months 11-14)
objectives: Achieve sub-500ms latency for sentiment classification and trend detection
Ensure full GDPR compliance with data anonymization and retention policies
deliverables: Real-time sentiment analysis engine with custom-trained multilingual models
Microservices architecture with Kafka-based event streaming infrastructure
Technical documentation and system architecture diagrams
content_data.risk_assessment: Medium-high risk due to complex real-time processing requirements, multi-language ML model accuracy challenges, and strict GDPR compliance constraints. Mitigation includes phased rollout, extensive load testing, and dedicated legal review cycles.
